description: Declarative surface of the human review layer. 'sections' is the closed set of sections both review.json and decisions.json may carry, in the order a reader meets them; a decisions file naming anything else is rejected whole. 'drop_cap_decisions' is the closed vocabulary of the drop_caps section's values, declared here so the validator refuses an unknown verdict from the batch the section is introduced in rather than from the batch that first consumes it. 'review_format_version' stamps every exported draft, so a draft written by an older layer is recognisable rather than silently reinterpreted.
